<template>
  <form @submit.prevent="submitForm">
    <v-text-field
      v-model="username"
      label="Username"
      required
    ></v-text-field>
    <v-text-field
      v-model="password"
      label="Password"
      type="password"
      required
    ></v-text-field>
    <v-btn type="submit" :loading="loading" :disabled="loading">
      Login
    </v-btn>
  </form>
</template>

<script>
import { ref } from 'vue'

export default {
  name: 'LoginForm',
  props: {
    loading: Boolean
  },
  emits: ['submit'],
  setup(props, { emit }) {
    const username = ref('')
    const password = ref('')

    const submitForm = () => {
      emit('submit', { username: username.value, password: password.value })
    }

    return { username, password, submitForm }
  }
}
</script>
